records.description: משפחת מודלי וידאו ליצירה מטקסט ורפרנסים ולעריכה, עם אודיו מקורי בגרסאות הנתמכות.

workflows.title: Multi-character dialogue
workflows.guidance: Generate performance and camera motion, then align the supplied audio to the intended speaker. Inspect lip timing and ensure background faces do not speak.

workflows.title: Image → motion → finishing
workflows.guidance: Develop consistent keyframes, animate selected shots, then finish music, sound and editing separately. Evaluate each stage for the job it performs.

workflows.title: Start and end frames
workflows.guidance: Test a short pilot on the exact model, version and host. Check final composition, identity, geometry and camera path before generating a batch.

workflows.title: Production cost and time
workflows.guidance: Compare usable outputs, total render and editing time, retries and quota exhaustion. Check current pricing, limits and hardware requirements.

workflows.title: Reproducible production
workflows.guidance: Keep model versions, prompts, input references, ordered clips, edit decisions and finishing steps together. Record manual steps and test the complete output chain.

workflows.title: Voice and lip-sync are separate tests
workflows.guidance: Evaluate meaning, pronunciation, accent and voice similarity separately from facial synchronization. Voice-over results do not establish lip-sync quality.

workflows.title: Generated images and programmed motion
workflows.guidance: Record which artwork was generated and which motion or effects were programmed. Code-driven animation can use image-generated source assets.
